items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
that they turn and encamp before Pihahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, over against Baalzephon
items.claim: The children of Israel were commanded to turn and encamp at Pihahiroth between Migdol and the sea
items.place: before Pihahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, over against Baalzephon
